booking.title: Request an appointment
booking.closed: Online booking is not available at the moment. Please call us.
booking.choose_type: What would you like an appointment for?
booking.choose_slot: Choose a free time. The practice will then confirm the appointment by text message.
booking.phone_hint: You will receive a code by text message.
booking.email_ok: Also receive the confirmation and reminders by e-mail (e-mail is not encrypted).
booking.prescription: I have a doctor’s prescription for physiotherapy.
booking.note_hint: Please do not include detailed health information – we will discuss it at the practice.
booking.consent: I agree that {practice} stores my details to arrange the appointment.
booking.code_intro: We have sent you a code by text message. Enter it here.
booking.sent_text: {practice} will check your request and confirm the appointment by text message. Only then is the appointment fixed.
booking.err_slot: This time is no longer valid. Please choose again.
booking.err_taken: This time has just been taken. Please choose another one.
booking.err_blocked: Too many attempts. Please try again later or call us.
booking.err_phone: Please enter a Swiss or Liechtenstein mobile number (e.g. 079 123 45 67).
booking.err_sms_limit: Several codes have already been sent to this number. Please try again in an hour or call us.
booking.err_expired: The request has expired. Please start again.
booking.err_busy: We cannot send any more codes right now. Please try again later or call us.

sms.booking_code: {practice}: your code for the appointment request: {code}
sms.booking_confirmed: {practice}: your appointment on {when} is confirmed ({place}). Please cancel at least 24 hours before: {phone}
sms.booking_declined: {practice}: unfortunately we cannot confirm the appointment on {when}. Please call us: {phone}
